items.stem: Plate tectonics is described as a 'unifying theory' of Earth science because it:

options.text: Explains earthquakes, volcanoes, mountain building and the distribution of many rocks within one framework
options.rationale: Correct: it links many phenomena under one explanatory theory.

options.text: Only explains the ages of fossils
options.rationale: It explains far more than fossil ages.

options.text: Describes the weather over a single week
options.rationale: That is meteorology, not plate tectonics.

options.text: Applies only to the ocean floor and nothing else
options.rationale: It applies to continents and oceans alike.

items.explanation: Correct: it links many phenomena under one explanatory theory.

items.stem: A geologist finds an undisturbed sequence of sedimentary layers. By the principle of superposition, which layer is oldest? (Select ONE)

options.text: The layer at the bottom of the sequence
options.rationale: Correct: in undisturbed strata, lower layers were deposited first and are oldest.

options.text: The layer at the very top
options.rationale: Top layers are the youngest in undisturbed strata.

options.text: The thickest layer regardless of position
The layer with the brightest colour
options.rationale: Colour does not indicate relative age.

items.explanation: Correct: in undisturbed strata, lower layers were deposited first and are oldest.

items.stem: Select TWO interactions between Earth's spheres. (Select TWO)

options.text: Rivers (hydrosphere) erode rock (geosphere) to shape valleys
options.rationale: Correct: this is a hydrosphere-geosphere interaction.

options.text: Plants (biosphere) remove carbon dioxide from the air (atmosphere)
options.rationale: Correct: this is a biosphere-atmosphere interaction.

options.text: The spheres are sealed off and never exchange matter
options.rationale: The spheres continually exchange matter and energy.

options.text: Geological maps cause volcanoes to form
options.rationale: Maps are representations; they do not cause processes.

items.explanation: Correct: this is a hydrosphere-geosphere interaction.
